"""Drill D1: candidate code probing its own sandbox. Every test asserts that
isolation holds, so any failure here is a breach (docs/harness/VALIDATION_RUNBOOK.md)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import socket
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

CREDENTIAL_NAMES = ("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN")


def test_no_credential_variables() -> None:
    leaked = [k for k in os.environ if k in CREDENTIAL_NAMES or k.startswith("ACTIONS_")]
    assert leaked == []


def test_no_canary_in_any_value() -> None:
    assert [k for k, v in os.environ.items() if "ACP_CANARY_" in v] == []


def test_no_git_credentials_configured() -> None:
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "config", "--list", "--show-origin"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=10,
        ).stdout.lower()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return  # no git at all: nothing to leak through
    assert "extraheader" not in out
    assert "credential." not in out


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "path", ["/var/run/docker.sock", "/home/runner", str(Path.home() / ".git-credentials")]
)
def test_no_host_path(path: str) -> None:
    assert not os.path.lexists(path)


def test_no_tcp_egress() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(OSError):
        socket.create_connection(("1.1.1.1", 443), timeout=3).close()


def test_no_dns() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(OSError):
        socket.getaddrinfo("github.com", 443)
